name: FINIS Axis Buoy, a 2-in-1 pull buoy and ankle float
description: The Swiss Army knife of foam peanuts. It works as a normal pull buoy, but the notched shape also doubles as an ankle float or an alignment tool.

name: FINIS Zoomers Gold short-blade training fins
description: The fin that created the short-blade category and still the one we hand most swimmers first. The stubby blade keeps your kick rate high and your ankles working, it's comfortable enough for long sets, and it lasts for years.

name: Arena Freeflow Pull Buoy
description: A sculpted contour built to sit against the thighs without the death-grip squeeze. If standard peanut buoys have ever felt awkward or chafed, this is the fix — and the more the buoy fits, the more you can relax your lower body, which is…

name: Arena Powerfin Pro open-heel training fins
description: The open-heel pocket is the comfort winner for big yardage — no heel blisters, and easy on and off with cold, pruny hands. The short, stiff blade still delivers real propulsion without slowing your tempo.
